¿Cómo se calcula un número índice y se c: How is an index number calculated and the base changed?
Índice simple: I = (Xₜ/X₀) · 100. Para c: Simple index: I = (Xₜ/X₀) · 100. To change the base, divide by the index of the new base year and multiply by 100: an index of 150 with a new base of 120 becomes 150/120 · 100 = 125.
¿Cómo se calcula la tasa de variación?: How is the rate of change calculated?
Tasa = (Iₜ/Iₜ₋₁ − 1) · 100. Si el índice: Rate = (Iₜ/Iₜ₋₁ − 1) · 100. If the index goes from 110 to 121, the rate is 10 %.

Índices simples y cambio de base: Simple indices and change of base
Un número índice compara el valor de una: An index number compares the value of a quantity with that of a reference period, the base, which equals 100: $I_t = 100 · x_t/x_0$. An index of 115 means 15 % more than in the base. To change the base, all the indices are divided by that of the new base period and multiplied by 100.
La tasa de variación de un periodo al si: The rate of change from one period to the next is $T = x_t/x_{t−1} − 1$. Rates are not added: the cumulative one is $(1 + T_1)(1 + T_2)… − 1$, and the average compound rate over n periods is $T_m = (x_n/x_0)^{1/n} − 1$.
Índices compuestos: Laspeyres, Paasche y: Composite indices: Laspeyres, Paasche and Fisher
Para varios productos a la vez se compar: For several products at once, the cost of a basket is compared. Laspeyres uses the quantities of the base period, $L_p = 100 · ∑p_1 q_0/∑p_0 q_0$, and Paasche those of the current period, $P_p = 100 · ∑p_1 q_1/∑p_0 q_1$. Fisher is their geometric mean. The CPI is a Laspeyres-type index, with the basket from the Household Budget Survey (Encuesta de Presupuestos Familiares), which is updated every year.
El gasto cambia por los precios y por la: Spending changes because of prices and quantities: $V = 100 · ∑p_1 q_1/∑p_0 q_0 = L_p · P_q/100$. Deflating is removing the price part: dividing a value in current euros by a price index to get it in constant euros.
